newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 21.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for July 21.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open to major shipping on Monday as tropical storms ebbed, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1500 local/2000 GMT daily meteorological report.
Pacific beach town Puerto Escondido was closed to smaller fishing and tourism boats because of high waves.

The remainders of Hurricane Danny, downgraded to a tropical depression, were sending stronger winds from 15 to 20 knots (16 to 22 miles/29 to 38 km per hour) to the Gulf of Mexico, with waves from five to seven feet high. Scattered rains reported throughout the country.
